desc: Parse input, build adjacency list, compute BFS distances dS[] from S and dT[] from T.
If dS[T] == INF (should not happen as graph is connected) or == 1: print -1.
Check condition 1: find any vertex x with dS[x] + dT[x] == D and 0 < dS[x] < D (i.e., on shortest path but not endpoints) and degree(x) >= 3. If exists -> answer = D + 2.
Else check condition 2: find any vertex y != S,T such that ((y adjacent to S and dT[y] == D-1) or (y adjacent to T and dS[y] == D-1)) and degree(y) >= 2. If exists -> answer = D + 1.
